description: Formatting ratchet (ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 6). Counts per file under artifacts/edge-tracker/src, comments stripped. CI fails when a file's count exceeds its baseline, a file not listed gets a match, or a rule total grows. Lower the numbers when you remove a match; never raise them.

ru-RU-literal.why: Locale is the UI language: use fmtCount / fmtDate / fmtMonth / fmtWeekday / localeTag() from @/lib/format.

notes.*: 0 at the end of the translation wave: dictation uses localeTagFor() (notes/author-dictation.ts). Keep it at 0.

new-intl.why: Intl objects live in lib/format and i18n/format (cached per language). Elsewhere only fixed-locale (en-US / en-CA / en-GB) formatters that compute New York date/time PARTS, never display text.

notes.*: All 16 are en-US/en-CA/en-GB NY-time part extractors (offsets, YYYY-MM-DD, hour). Candidates to fold into lib/trading-date (nyDate / NY parts) in phase E.

date-fns-locale.why: Hard-coded date-fns locales (ru) freeze the language. Text: fmtDate & co; a component that needs a date-fns Locale object uses dateFnsLocale() from @/lib/format/date-fns-locale.
